
```{r, results='asis'}

figtab <- dplyr::case_when(
  grepl(pattern = "fig-", x = nickname[1]) ~ "fig",
  grepl(pattern = "tab-", x = nickname[1]) ~ "tab"
)

dir0 <- dir_out_figtab # here::here("output", paste0("figtab_", maxyr)) # 

nickname0 <- list.files(path = dir0, nickname)
nickname0 <- unique(substr(nickname0, 1, regexpr("\\.", nickname0)-1))

src_figtab <- list()

for(i in 1:length(nickname0)){
  nickname00 <- nickname0[i]
  
  if (figtab == "tab"){
    path <- paste0(dir0, nickname00, ".Rdata")
    load(path) 
    caption <- obj$caption
    
  } else if (figtab == "fig" & !grepl(x = nickname00, pattern = "-gif")) {
    caption <- readtext(file = paste0(dir0, nickname00, ".txt"))$text
    path <- paste0(dir0, nickname00, ifelse(exists("quarto") && quarto, ".Rdata", ".png"))
    img <- magick::image_read(path = paste0(dir0, nickname00, ".png")) 
    img.asp <- magick::image_info(img)$height / magick::image_info(img)$width 
    fig.width <- 6.5
  }
  
  src_figtab[[i]] <- knitr::knit_expand(file = paste0(dir_code, '_child_report_', figtab, '.Rmd'))
}

# CRITICAL FIX: Use \n\n to prevent chunks from fusing together!
res <- knitr::knit_child(text = paste0(unlist(src_figtab), collapse = "\n\n"), quiet = TRUE)

cat(res, sep = ifelse(exists("sep0"), sep0, '\n')) 
if(exists("sep0")){remove(sep0)}
```
